WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM account_order_counts
), account_differences AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        region,
        order_count,
        order_count - avg_order_count AS difference
    FROM account_order_counts
    CROSS JOIN overall_average
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(difference) AS avg_difference
    FROM account_differences
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    ad.account_id,
    ad.region,
    ad.order_count,
    ad.difference,
    ad.difference - ra.avg_difference AS excess_over_region_average
FROM account_differences AS ad
JOIN region_averages AS ra ON ra.region = ad.region
WHERE ad.difference > ra.avg_difference
ORDER BY excess_over_region_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
